    def dump(self):return self.model_dump_json()

for source,name in [(schema,'MessageQueue'),(role,'RoleReactMode'),(role,'RoleContext')]:
    node=next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==name)
    nodes.append(node)
    module=ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__',names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')],level=0),node],type_ignores=[]))
    exec(compile(module,'source-derived-'+name,'exec'),globals())
MessageQueue.model_rebuild(); RoleContext.model_rebuild()
async def run():
    records=[]
    for n in [0,1,3]:
        context=RoleContext(memory=Memory(storage=[Message(id='observed',content='old')]))
        for i in range(n):context.msg_buffer.push(Message(id=f'pending-{i}',content=f'body-{i}'))
        model=context.model_dump()
        restored=RoleContext.model_validate(model)
        lost=[m.id for m in restored.msg_buffer.pop_all()]
        explicit=await context.msg_buffer.dump()
        helper=MessageQueue.load(explicit)
        recovered=[m.id for m in helper.pop_all()]
        assert 'msg_buffer' not in model and lost==[]
        assert recovered==[f'pending-{i}' for i in range(n)]
        assert restored.memory.storage[0].id=='observed'
        records.append(dict(pendingInput=n,serializedKeys=sorted(model),restoredPendingIDs=lost,retainedObservedIDs=[m.id for m in restored.memory.storage],explicitHelperRestoredIDs=recovered))
    return records
